documentation.usageCode:
import {
  ImageCropperRoot,
  ImageCropperViewport,
  ImageCropperImage,
  ImageCropperCropArea,
  ImageCropperHandle,
  ImageCropperZoomControl,
  ImageCropperStatus,
} from '@uifn/components-react/image-cropper'
import '@uifn/components/styles.css'

export function Example() {
  return (
    <ImageCropperRoot src="data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAAD/ACwAAAAAAQABAAACADs=" defaultCrop={{"x":0,"y":0,"width":100,"height":100}}>
      <ImageCropperViewport>
        viewport example
        <ImageCropperImage />
        <ImageCropperCropArea>
          <ImageCropperHandle value="nw" />
          <ImageCropperHandle value="ne" />
          <ImageCropperHandle value="sw" />
          <ImageCropperHandle value="se" />
        </ImageCropperCropArea>
        <ImageCropperZoomControl />
        <ImageCropperStatus>Ready</ImageCropperStatus>
      </ImageCropperViewport>
    </ImageCropperRoot>
  )
}

documentation.usageCode:
import {
  SliderRoot,
  SliderLabel,
  SliderControl,
  SliderTrack,
  SliderRange,
  SliderThumb,
  SliderValueText,
  SliderHiddenInput,
} from '@uifn/components-react/slider'
import '@uifn/components/styles.css'

export function Example() {
  return (
    <SliderRoot defaultValue={[64]} min={0} max={100} name="slider" aria-label="Slider example">
      <SliderLabel>Example label</SliderLabel>
      <SliderControl>
        control example
        <SliderTrack>
          <SliderRange />
        </SliderTrack>
        <SliderThumb value={0} />
      </SliderControl>
      <SliderValueText value={0}>Current value</SliderValueText>
      <SliderHiddenInput value={0} />
    </SliderRoot>
  )
}

documentation.usageCode:
import {
  ColorPickerRoot,
  ColorPickerLabel,
  ColorPickerControl,
  ColorPickerTrigger,
  ColorPickerPositioner,
  ColorPickerContent,
  ColorPickerArea,
  ColorPickerAreaThumb,
  ColorPickerChannelSlider,
  ColorPickerChannelInput,
  ColorPickerSwatch,
  ColorPickerHiddenInput,
} from '@uifn/components-react/color-picker'
import '@uifn/components/styles.css'

export function Example() {
  return (
    <ColorPickerRoot name="color-picker">
      <ColorPickerLabel>Example label</ColorPickerLabel>
      <ColorPickerControl>
        control example
        <ColorPickerTrigger type="button">Open example</ColorPickerTrigger>
        <ColorPickerSwatch />
      </ColorPickerControl>
      <ColorPickerPositioner>
        <ColorPickerContent>
          Component content
          <ColorPickerArea>
            <ColorPickerAreaThumb />
          </ColorPickerArea>
          <ColorPickerChannelSlider value="r" />
          <ColorPickerChannelInput value="r" />
        </ColorPickerContent>
      </ColorPickerPositioner>
      <ColorPickerHiddenInput />
    </ColorPickerRoot>
  )
}
